title: Fetching all hive metadata failed issues
body:
Hi all. I'm trying to find solution about fetching all hive metadata tables. Here is the information.

### Environment

trino version - 419
hive version - 2.3.3 or 3.1.3

`hive.metastore-timeout=5m`

### Problem

When I execute below query, it failed due to hive metastore timeout error. but under trino 417 works well within 3~4 minutes.

`select * from hive.information_schema.tables`

![image](https://github.com/trinodb/trino/assets/56464741/f15f0425-d2af-443f-956f-72591e0194ba)


### Root Cause

https://github.com/trinodb/trino/pull/17127

after 418 version, fetching all hive metadata logic has been changed.

For the < 418 version, it follows below logics

1. get all schemas
2. get all tables each schema
3. concat the results and return it.

For the >= 418 version,  it follows below logics

1. get all tables at once.
2. concat the results and return it.

This changes may happened too much load for hive metastore so that needed lots of memory compared with before.
In my case, # of tables are around 500,000 so it definitely get too much stress for hivemetastore.

Is there any solution about this?

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
@participant2 It seems that there is no impact on other databases. This problem only happen when I execute below query.
```
select * from hive.information_schema.tables
```
But if there is some where clause, it works well.
```
select * from hive.information_schema.tables where and table_schema='example_schema'
```

comments.body: But it is an issue in HMS right ? From JIRA it looks like it was introduced in 3.0 and fixed in 3.2

comments.author: participant2
comments.body:
Yes. But from UX perspective it is Trino issue, as everything was working and then after update it is failing. So I think kill switch is needed to mitigate issues during the transition period when people will start to use HMS which is free from this issue.

@reporter Is it possible for you to update HMS and check if the issue is still there?
